documentation.note: README/docs are extensive, but Quick Start still encodes the sibling-checkout coupling and scope language requires final adjudication against current ownership boundaries.

deployment_readiness.note: Release-check success is bounded to demo mode against an empty DB and cannot certify production deployment readiness.
